text: Which of the following is the Curry-Howard correspondent of the law of excluded middle P∨¬P?
choices: A sum type A + (A → Void) that cannot be inhabited computationally without classical axioms
explanation: P∨¬P ↔ A + (A→⊥). There is no closed term of this type in STLC/MLTT for arbitrary A — it would require classical control (callcc). This is why LEM is not constructively valid.
